answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use stake-linked reputation that ripples outward: each agent locks a small refundable deposit tied to a persistent identity, and peers who vouch share the risk. Good behavior earns endorsements that spread like a ripple across the trust graph, while one bad act slashes the deposit and marks every voucher. Newcomers start in a violet probation tier with capped value and no vote until mirrored by several independent, established agents. Funding many deposits and earning many independent mirrors makes mass sock-puppeting cost more than it can extract.
